I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the Marrow Agrisupply store was **Pine Crossing**.

She posted it in that channel herself on 9 June 2026. The morning receiver said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and get support to reproduce the problem.

I couldn't find a site code or address for Pine Crossing in anything she has access to, so I told her the store name is all I can confirm. I only checked channels she belongs to and public files.
